_doc: Emberlight style baseline for tests/client_smoke/style_check.gd (art bible, Colour). shots: the noon and night spawn shots' colour measures (llvmpipe, 1280x720, HUD masked). big: a move this far away from the art bible fails the Test check. small: a move this far either way is printed for the integrator. A world PR that changes the look on purpose reruns the check with --write-baseline and says so. 2026-11-24, grounded art direction (owner direction, art bible sections 0 and 11): baseline rewritten on purpose. Noon is darker and far less saturated (olive, not lime: luma 0.74 -> 0.54, sat 0.43 -> 0.30), and night moved toward the art bible (blue over green, cool, neon share 0.62 -> ~0.05).
